fields.description: Used when a Down Payment Invoice is created from a Sales Order (partial bill). Fills Position Name and Position Description on the new invoice. Optional Jinja: {{ doc.fieldname }} where doc is the draft Down Payment Invoice (e.g. sales_order, down_payment_percentage, down_payment_amount, customer, company).
fields.label: Default Position Settings

fields.description: Default for Position Name on the new invoice. Plain text or Jinja (context: doc = draft Down Payment Invoice). Example: Anzahlungsrechnung or {{ doc.sales_order }}.
fields.label: Default Position Name

fields.default: Es werden {{ doc.down_payment_percentage }} % des Gesamtauftragswerts in Rechnung gestellt.
fields.description: Default for Position Description (print / PDF). Rich text and Jinja allowed; same doc as above. Example: Anzahlung ({{ doc.down_payment_percentage }} % of order {{ doc.sales_order }}).
fields.label: Default Position Description
